title: Origin story: Baba Yaga
description: Baba Yaga is the witch of Slavic folklore who dwells in a hut standing on chicken legs, flying in a mortar steered with a pestle. She is neither good nor evil: she eats the rude and aids the worthy, testing heroes like Vasilisa with impossible tasks and rewarding those who pass.
